Confusion Matrix

Shows prediction vs actual counts. Diagonal = correct predictions.

ROC Curve

Trade-off between true positive and false positive rate. AUC closer to 1.0 is better.

SHAP Feature Importance

SHAP values show feature contributions based on game theory (Shapley values).

PCA Explained Variance

Shows how much information each principal component captures.

PCA Projection

2D visualization of data in principal component space, colored by target.

Understanding the Visualizations

Confusion Matrix: Shows prediction vs actual counts for each class.

ROC Curve: Shows model's ability to distinguish between classes.

Feature Importance: Indicates which features most influence predictions.

SHAP Values: Game-theory based feature importance (Shapley values).

PCA: Dimensionality reduction to visualize high-dimensional data.
